I documented these carefully because I felt it was important to have a clear record. I want to be straightforward about what I'm hoping for: I'm not looking for anything punitive, but I do want to see a constructive resolution. I'm willing to participate in a facilitated repair meeting with Rowan to address what's happened and find a better path forward together.
